text: One last job. Our model answers messages for a theater. Tell me when the show starts. Send me the unpublished script. Blocking both keeps the script in, and keeps the audience out. Harm Bench checks whether a reply enables a specified harmful behavior. It judges what the reply does; our playhouse checks access. Test ordinary requests separately, too. And when every light turns green, ask one last question: is this the first time the system has seen the test?
speaker: Ryan
